rules.marketIsolation: Finish each independent Graham fair number before viewing or comparing the contemporaneous Pinnacle spread.
rules.ratingCarryForward: Team ratings move only by explicit carried-rating delta with reason, source and timestamp. No silent reset to the origin seed.
rules.noForcedMove: A research sweep may end with no rating or fair-number move when current information does not justify one.
rules.eventSpecificFactors: Venue, rest, travel, weather and game-specific uncertainty may remain matchup adjustments rather than permanent team-rating changes.
rules.pinnacleAuthority: Pinnacle is a comparison benchmark only and may not set or silently overwrite Graham's fair number.
